intro: How to use the clan bot.

fullExtra: A boss page syncs only after you open it in game. If one boss will not score, open its page and press the button again.
short: Stats and KC need nothing. The bot looks your name up on Wise Old Man.
Your collection log needs RuneProfile:
1. Open your RuneLite client.
2. Open the Plugin Hub (bottom of the plugin list).
3. Search for RuneProfile.
4. Click Install.
5. Log in on the account. There is no RSN to type in, it reads the account you're on.
6. Open your Collection Log and press the RuneProfile button in the top-left.
topics.title: RSN Sync

fullExtra: Data comes from Wise Old Man and RuneProfile.
`/pb` reads PBs from the clan plugin. This feature works when our clan plugin is live.

images.caption: What `/kc zulrah` posts: the kill count and the collection log items.
What `/clog` posts: your whole log and every tab.
What `/dry zulrah` posts: what you're dry on, and your luck.
What `/gains` posts: XP and KC gained, last 7 or 30 days.

short: `/kc zulrah` - Boss kills and its collection log items.
`/clog` - Your whole log, or one page.
`/skills` - Levels and XP.
`/dry zulrah` - What you're dry on, and your luck.
`/gains` - XP and KC, last 7 or 30 days.
topics.title: Cards

fullExtra: The text versions came first. The slash versions are in the picker under `/`.
short: Every card command has a text version. Type it in any channel, or in a DM.
`!kc zulrah` · `!clog` · `!skills`
`!dry zulrah` · `!gains` · `!compare`
`!pb` · `!profile` · `!leaderboard`
Boss names work alone: `!toa`, `!zulrah`. Same card `/kc` posts.
Shortcuts: `!log` = clog, `!lvl` = skills. Plain names work: `!kc nightmare`.
topics.title: Text commands

images.caption: The Overall view: totals side by side.
A boss head to head: kill counts, both collection logs, and the luck on each drop.

short: `/compare RSN1 RSN2`. One name compares them against you.
The buttons on the card do the rest. Only you can press yours.
topics.title: Compare

fullExtra: Want the ping when a new one posts? Take the Bounty Hunter role in #roles.
Plugin drops can back up your proof. This feature works when our clan plugin is live.

images.caption: A contract poster. Press Submit Proof under it to open your proof thread.

short: Contracts hang in #bounty-board. Two at a time, one PvM, one Skilling.
The drop has to be earned after the contract posts. Screenshot it, press **Submit Proof** on the poster.
Staff make the final call.
topics.title: Bounties

fullExtra: **Gains are empty.** Gains build from daily snapshots, so a new name needs a day or two before numbers show.
**A clog page will not come up.** Use the page's in-game name, like `!clog hard clues`. Boss and raid pages show on the KC card instead.
short: **A number is missing.** That page may not be synced yet. The RSN Sync topic has the steps.
**The collection log is not synced.** The RSN Sync topic has the steps.
**A drop did not count for a bounty.** Check the contract posted before the drop landed. If it did, ask staff in your proof thread.
